definitions.gloss: different color; color variation; alternate color version
definitions.explanation: The same item in a different color. Widely used in shopping, fashion, and gaming (especially for rare alternate-colored creatures in games).

examples.japanese: {色違|いろちが}い⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I also bought it in a different color.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{色違|いろちが}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you have this shirt in another color?

examples.japanese: ⟦{気|き}に{入|い}った→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{色違|いろちが}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三枚|さんまい}⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまった。
examples.english: I liked it so much that I ended up buying three in different colors.

examples.japanese: {色違|いろちが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ポケモン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Finding a shiny Pokémon is extremely difficult.

notes:
A practical compound noun used daily in shopping and fashion to refer to the same product in a different color option. Also extremely popular in gaming culture, especially Pokémon, where {色違|いろちが}い refers to rare alternate-colored creatures (called "shiny" in English).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色違|いろちが}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy in different colors
- {色違|いろちが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: the same product in a different color
- {色違|いろちが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ポケモン: shiny Pokémon
- {色違|いろちが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect color variants

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ as a modifier ({色違|いろちが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スカート→スカート：01060_sukaato⟧) or with で to indicate manner ({色違|いろちが}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧ — to get a matching set in different colors). In online shopping, {色違|いろちが}い is a standard filter option.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: another color (descriptive phrase, not a set term)
- ⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧バリエーション: color variation (loanword, used in product catalogs)
